description: Create packages/shared with APP_NAME constant, Zod schemas (HealthResponse), and common TypeScript types. This package is imported by both web and API for type safety and validation.
steps: Create packages/shared/package.json with name @orbit/shared, type: module, main: ./dist/index.js, exports: ./dist/index.js, scripts: build (tsc), test (vitest), devDependencies: typescript, vitest, zod
Create packages/shared/tsconfig.json extending ../../packages/config/tsconfig.base.json with compilerOptions: outDir ./dist, rootDir ./src, declaration: true
Create packages/shared/src/constants.ts exporting `export const APP_NAME = 'ORBIT' as const;`

Create packages/shared/src/schemas/health.schema.ts with Zod schema: `export const HealthResponseSchema = z.object({ status: z.literal('ok'), timestamp: z.string(), version: z.string() }); export type HealthResponse = z.infer<typeof HealthResponseSchema>;`
Create packages/shared/src/types/index.ts with common TypeScript utility types (e.g., `export type Brand<K, T> = K & { __brand: T };`)
Create packages/shared/src/index.ts exporting all from constants, schemas/health.schema, and types
Create packages/shared/src/__tests__/schemas.test.ts verifying HealthResponseSchema parses valid input and rejects invalid
Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/shared test` to verify tests pass
acceptance_criteria: APP_NAME constant is exported and equals 'ORBIT'
HealthResponseSchema correctly validates { status: 'ok', timestamp: string, version: string }
Package can be imported by other workspace packages using workspace:* protocol
verification: Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/shared build` and confirm dist/ directory is created with index.js and index.d.ts
Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/shared test` and confirm all tests pass
Run `pnpm type-check` from root and confirm no errors
